meta.title: Add community profile and like button to ThemeView
meta.body_summary: Optimize theme fetching by combining two sequential database queries into a single getThemeWithCommunity query, reducing round-trips and eliminating extra network requests.

perf_labels.notes: Devin combined two sequential DB queries into one; merged without human review despite Vercel/Cloudflare build failures.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 206 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume. It is a compact performance optimization that merged without review friction, fitting a fast‑tracked, low‑risk change.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review captured; only automated bot comments (CodeRabbit skipped, Vercel and Cloudflare build failures).
review_details.performance_claim: Reduces number of database queries from two to one, eliminating sequential requests and extra network overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Straightforward query combination; merged without human review, indicating low friction for small data‑access optimisations even with failing CI deployments.

core_change_summary.description: Added getThemeWithCommunity function in actions/themes.ts that fetches both theme and community theme in a single Prisma query, replacing two separate fetches. Updated page component and ThemeView to use the combined data.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Minor changes in community-themes.ts support like‑button UI; core performance change is the single‑query refactor in themes.ts.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added community profile and like button UI with separate theme and community theme fetches.
Second commit: Refactored to single getThemeWithCommunity query in actions/themes.ts, updated page component to use it, removing sequential request.
